design_name: Directorate colony industry module with greenhouse
rationale: KSA-67 template. The Duna lander layout carrying the hardware that makes a base self-sufficient: a Convert-O-Tron 125 under the Mk1-3 pod, two Drill-O-Matic Juniors and four OX-STAT panels on the X200-32 lander with a Poodle. Kerbalism version: a greenhouse sits between the pod and the converter to grow food. It lands and stays. Transfer stage: two X200-32 and a Poodle. Launch: Mainsail on an X200-32 and two X200-64 with four Kickbacks.
